It is said that a day as husband and wife brings a hundred days of kindness.
I, Erniang, was fortunate to meet you, and our wedding was celebrated on a harmonious spring day, our Rare bond formed as I came of age.
Yet the noble house collapsed overnight. I wished to shatter like jade and follow you in death, but instead, you sent me away with a letter to Hexi.
I know your cold words of dismissal were meant to protect me.
In this life, I may never see you again. I will forge a path through hardship, striving for survival in this dire situation, so as not to betray your efforts.
Looking back, I have traversed the desert sands and shouldered great responsibilities. If we meet again in the afterlife, I will surely make you proud.
Our bond in this life was fleeting, but I pray for the next. I have no regrets, and I hope you will always know this.
Liu Si'an   Farewell
